resources.string: You have no recordings to be displayed. Press record to start a recording.
This app allows you to use the your device\'s light sensor in order to display the current light level or to record light levels.

Before using the app it is recommended to choose the folder in which your recordings will be saved. To do that simply click on the folder icon in the top right corner and choose a (safe) folder or create a new one which is recommended.
When measuring you can reset the "MIN" and "MAX" values with the reset button.
After making a recording you can rename it by typing ".json" or by changing focus to another recording. You can also delete the recordings and open the previously chosen folder for saving.
